name: How does a tub-to-shower conversion improve home accessibility?

mainEntity.name: How does a tub-to-shower conversion improve home accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a tub to a low-threshold or curbless shower significantly improves safety for aging in place or limited mobility. Stepping over a conventional tub rim is a frequent cause of bathroom slips. Conversions allow for barrier-free entry, slip-resistant flooring, anchored grab bars, handheld sprayers, and built-in bench seating. These functional modifications support multigenerational living arrangements and enable seniors to maintain independence in their existing homes without sacrificing aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: It eliminates the barrier of stepping over a tall bathtub ledge and allows for safety enhancements such as grab bars, non-slip floors, and integrated seating.
